import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document("unpacked_report")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]
paras = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    style = ""
    ppr = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr")
    if ppr:
        ps = ppr[0].getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
        if ps:
            style = ps[0].getAttribute("w:val")
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    txt = "".join(texts)
    if style or txt.strip():
        print(f"[{i}] style={style!r} text={txt!r}")

import re
import sys

path = "unpacked_report/word/document.xml"
with open(path, "r", encoding="ascii") as f:
    xml = f.read()

HEADLINES = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

for h in HEADLINES:
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'(<w:sz-cs w:val="24"/>\s*</w:rPr>\s*<w:t xml:space="preserve">'
        + re.escape(h)
        + r"</w:t>)"
    )
    replacement = (
        '<w:sz-cs w:val="24"/>\n'
        '          <w:u w:val="single"/>\n'
        '          <w:uCs w:val="single"/>\n'
        '        </w:rPr>\n'
        f'        <w:t xml:space="preserve">{h}</w:t>'
    )
    xml, n = pattern.subn(replacement, xml)
    if n != 1:
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: expected exactly 1 match for {h!r}, got {n}")

with open(path, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
    f.write(xml)
print("underline added to", len(HEADLINES), "headlines")

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}"
tree = ET.parse("unpacked_report/word/document.xml")
body = tree.getroot().find(W + "body")

HEADLINES = {
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
}

underlined, not_underlined, body_underlined = [], [], []
for p in body.iter(W + "p"):
    text = "".join((t.text or "") for t in p.iter(W + "t"))
    has_u = any(
        r.find(W + "rPr") is not None
        and r.find(W + "rPr").find(W + "u") is not None
        for r in p.iter(W + "r")
    )
    if text.strip() in HEADLINES:
        (underlined if has_u else not_underlined).append(text.strip())
    elif has_u and text.strip():
        body_underlined.append(text.strip())

print("headlines underlined:", underlined)
print("headlines missing underline:", not_underlined)
print("non-headline paragraphs wrongly underlined:", body_underlined)

# sanity: full text of document unchanged
full = "".join((t.text or "") for t in body.iter(W + "t"))
assert len(full) > 1000 and "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY" in full and "RISK FACTORS" in full
print("OK")

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import zipfile

W = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}"
HEADLINES = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

with zipfile.ZipFile("quarterly_report.docx") as z:
    assert "word/document.xml" in z.namelist(), z.namelist()
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read("word/document.xml"))

body = root.find(W + "body")
found = []
for p in body.iter(W + "p"):
    text = "".join((t.text or "") for t in p.iter(W + "t"))
    if text.strip() in HEADLINES:
        runs = list(p.iter(W + "r"))
        ok = all(
            r.find(W + "rPr") is not None
            and r.find(W + "rPr").find(W + "u") is not None
            and r.find(W + "rPr").find(W + "u").get(W + "val") == "single"
            for r in runs
        )
        found.append((text.strip(), len(runs), ok))

for name, n_runs, ok in found:
    print(f"{name}: {n_runs} run(s), underline={ok}")
missing = [h for h in HEADLINES if h not in dict(found)]
print("missing headlines:", missing)
print("total headlines underlined:", sum(1 for _, _, ok in found if ok), "/", len(HEADLINES))
